rules.name: recon-trades-02-funnel-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT 'rows' AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM dbsystemuat.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate UNION ALL SELECT 'distinct_trades_raw', count(DISTINCT trade_id) FROM dbsystemuat.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate UNION ALL SELECT 'distinct_trades_without_suffix', count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN trade_id LIKE '%-CFS' THEN LEFT(trade_id, CHAR_LENGTH(trade_id) - 4) ELSE trade_id END) FROM dbsystemuat.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate UNION ALL SELECT 'rows_with_suffix', count(*) FROM dbsystemuat.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate AND trade_id LIKE '%-CFS'

SELECT 'rows' AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND settlement_date = :valueDate UNION ALL SELECT 'distinct_trades_raw', count(DISTINCT trade_id) FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND settlement_date = :valueDate UNION ALL SELECT 'distinct_trades_without_suffix', count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN trade_id::text LIKE '%-CFS' THEN left(trade_id::text, length(trade_id::text) - 4) ELSE trade_id::text END) FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND settlement_date = :valueDate UNION ALL SELECT 'rows_with_suffix', count(*) FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND settlement_date = :valueDate AND trade_id::text LIKE '%-CFS'
SELECT DISTINCT trade_id, contract_number, counterparty_parent FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs
SELECT DISTINCT trade_id::text AS trade_id, contract_number, counterparty_parent FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT DISTINCT d.trade_id, d.contract_number, d.counterparty_parent FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs d JOIN dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs a ON a.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE a.value_date = :valueDate

SELECT DISTINCT d.trade_id::text AS trade_id, d.contract_number, d.counterparty_parent FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d JOIN opera.deal_active_lots_table a ON a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.business_unit = d.business_unit AND a.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND a.value_date = :valueDate

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.trade_id LIKE '%-CFS' THEN LEFT(c.trade_id, CHAR_LENGTH(c.trade_id) - 4) ELSE c.trade_id END AS trade_id, c.contract_number, c.counterparty_parent FROM dbsystemuat.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table_cfs c WHERE c.value_date = :valueDate

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.trade_id::text LIKE '%-CFS' THEN left(c.trade_id::text, length(c.trade_id::text) - 4) ELSE c.trade_id::text END AS trade_id, c.contract_number, c.counterparty_parent FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.settlement_date = :valueDate

stage.reason: all cloned deal tickets of CFS
deal has an active-lots row on the value date
deal is in the recon settle cache (legacy) or snapshot (new) of the date, BU suffix removed

expect.reason: rows, trades with and without suffix and suffix rows are equal on both sides
legacy and new keep the same trades at every stage
